newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar ends off at 480.60/481.75 dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar ends off at 480.60/481.75 dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly softer against the dollar at 480.60/481.75 on increased corporate demand for dollars, traders said.
The unit closed at 480.00/481.00 per dollar on Thursday.

"The Central Bank was there but did not cover the whole market," one trader said. Another one said "the adjustment was expected ... because there is to be some depreciation in order to reach the end-of-month levels set by the Central Bank."
